title.en: Recurrent palpitations and chest tightness · 42-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位心脏瓣膜病女性入院手术，术后住院期间出现新的问题：沿着时间线复核病情、用药和检查。
summary.en: A woman with valve disease is admitted for surgery, and a new problem appears during her post-operative stay: follow her condition, medicines and results along the timeline.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 预见胺碘酮–华法林相互作用：合用时预先将华法林减量约 1/3–1/2，并在之后数周每隔几天复查INR。
learningOutcomes.en: Anticipate the amiodarone–warfarin interaction: reduce warfarin by about one-third to one-half when the two are started together and check the INR every few days for the following weeks.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用胺碘酮的药代动力学解释加用后INR延迟、非线性的升高。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain a delayed, non-linear INR rise after amiodarone starts, using amiodarone's pharmacokinetics.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按ACC 2020共识的大出血标准给维生素K拮抗剂相关出血分级，再决定是否逆转，并说明为何非大出血一般不用逆转剂。
learningOutcomes.en: Grade bleeding on a vitamin K antagonist by the ACC 2020 major-bleeding criteria before choosing reversal, and explain why non-major bleeds generally need no reversal agent.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 出血停止后以较低剂量尽早恢复抗凝，并制定出院后的INR监测计划，权衡新生物瓣和房颤的血栓风险。
learningOutcomes.en: Restart anticoagulation early at a lower dose once bleeding stops and set an INR plan after discharge, weighing the thrombotic risk of a new bioprosthesis and AF.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别医嘱单上并存的相互作用（胺碘酮–地高辛），并如实为单一病例的药物不良反应做因果分级。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify co-existing interactions on the drug chart (amiodarone–digoxin) and grade causality honestly in a single-case adverse drug reaction.

triageNote.en: 42-year-old woman admitted to the ward with 14 years of exertional palpitations and chest tightness, worse for a week with swollen legs. Admission observations: T 36.4 °C, pulse 84/min, RR 19/min, BP 128/86 mmHg.

text.en: Admission diagnoses: (1) severe tricuspid regurgitation; (2) moderate mitral regurgitation; (3) after repair of an Ebstein anomaly; (4) atrial fibrillation. After admission: oral furosemide 20 mg, spironolactone 20 mg and metoprolol succinate 47.5 mg, each once daily.

text.zh-CN: 入院第9天行三尖瓣生物瓣膜置换＋二尖瓣成形＋房颤射频消融术。术后第1天起口服华法林 3.00 mg/d，同时口服地高辛 0.125 mg、厄贝沙坦 0.15 g，均每日1次。术后第3天PT 15.5 s、INR 1.3，华法林增至 3.75 mg/d。术后第8天再次出现心房颤动（心率 81 次/分），PT 21.3 s、INR 1.9，团队计划加用胺碘酮 0.2 g口服，每日1次。原报告没有说明术前的呋塞米、螺内酯和美托洛尔术后是否继续。
text.en: Hospital day 9: bioprosthetic tricuspid valve replacement, mitral valve repair and radiofrequency ablation of AF. From postoperative day 1: oral warfarin 3.00 mg/day with digoxin 0.125 mg and irbesartan 0.15 g, each once daily. Day 3: PT 15.5 s, INR 1.3; warfarin increased to 3.75 mg/day. Day 8: atrial fibrillation recurred (heart rate 81/min) with PT 21.3 s and INR 1.9, and the team plans oral amiodarone 0.2 g once daily. The report does not say whether the pre-operative furosemide, spironolactone and metoprolol continued after surgery.

text.zh-CN: 术后第8天：加用胺碘酮 0.2 g每日1次，华法林维持 3.75 mg/d。术后第14天PT 26.0 s、INR 2.2，华法林减至 3.00 mg/d；第15天PT 27.9 s、INR 2.4，减至 2.25 mg/d。第16天出现肉眼血尿。
text.en: Postoperative day 8: amiodarone 0.2 g once daily started, warfarin kept at 3.75 mg/day. Day 14: PT 26.0 s, INR 2.2; warfarin reduced to 3.00 mg/day. Day 15: PT 27.9 s, INR 2.4; reduced to 2.25 mg/day. Day 16: visible haematuria.

text.zh-CN: 正文未列血尿时血红蛋白下降幅度、血流动力学或输血需求；不能据现有资料自动分为大出血或轻微出血。
text.en: The haemoglobin change, haemodynamics at the time of bleeding and transfusion needs are not reported; available evidence does not establish a major or minor bleeding category.

text.zh-CN: 原报告没有给出术后任何血红蛋白、血小板或其他血常规结果。
text.en: The report gives no haemoglobin, platelet count or other blood count after surgery.

text.zh-CN: 原报告没有给出地高辛血药浓度。
text.en: The report gives no digoxin level.

text.zh-CN: 原报告没有给出地高辛血药浓度。
text.en: The report gives no digoxin level.

text.zh-CN: 原报告没有给出术后的肝功能、肾功能或白蛋白。
text.en: The report gives no liver tests, renal function or albumin after surgery.

text.zh-CN: 原报告没有给出术后的肝功能、肾功能或白蛋白。
text.en: The report gives no liver tests, renal function or albumin after surgery.

text.zh-CN: 原报告没有做或没有报告尿培养。
text.en: No urine culture is reported.

name.en: Review the treatment and discharge record

text.zh-CN: 原报告的处理：术后第16天停用华法林，其余治疗不变（胺碘酮维持原剂量），肌内注射维生素K₁ 10 mg；4小时后PT 48.2 s、INR 4.1，再次肌内注射维生素K₁ 10 mg；又4小时后PT 18.7 s、INR 1.6，尿色逐渐恢复正常。次日尿红细胞计数阴性，PT 16.6 s、INR 1.4，恢复口服华法林 1.50 mg/d，其余治疗不变。术后第17天各项指标基本正常，未再出现血尿，当日出院。原报告没有记录出院后的INR、再次出血或血栓情况，也没有写明抗凝目标范围。
text.en: Reported management: on postoperative day 16 warfarin was stopped and all other treatment continued (amiodarone at the same dose), with vitamin K1 10 mg intramuscularly; 4 h later PT 48.2 s and INR 4.1, so a second 10 mg intramuscular dose was given; 4 h after that PT 18.7 s and INR 1.6, and the urine colour gradually returned to normal. The next day the urine red-cell count was negative, PT 16.6 s and INR 1.4, and oral warfarin was restarted at 1.50 mg/day with no other change. On postoperative day 17 her results were described as essentially normal, there was no further haematuria, and she was discharged that day. The report records no INR after discharge, no later bleeding or thrombosis, and no target INR range.

note.zh-CN: 原文内部不一致：英文摘要写“第17天PT 18.7 s、INR 1.6”，而中文摘要和正文均为第17天（次日）PT 16.6 s、INR 1.4；18.7 s/1.6是正文中第二次注射维生素K₁后4小时的数值。本病例以正文为准，并保留此标注。
note.en: Internal inconsistency in the source: the English abstract gives PT 18.7 s and INR 1.6 on day 17, whereas the Chinese abstract and the main text give PT 16.6 s and INR 1.4 on day 17 (the next day); 18.7 s/1.6 are the main text's values 4 h after the second vitamin K1 dose. The case follows the main text and keeps this note.

name.zh-CN: 胺碘酮 0.2 g 口服，每日1次

dose.zh-CN: 胺碘酮 0.2 g口服，每日1次。

response.zh-CN: 已开具胺碘酮 0.2 g每日1次。
response.en: Amiodarone 0.2 g once daily is charted.

name.zh-CN: 加用胺碘酮时预先减少华法林剂量
name.en: Pre-emptive warfarin dose reduction for amiodarone

dose.zh-CN: 在当前剂量基础上减量约 1/3–1/2，此后按INR调整。
dose.en: Reduce the current dose by about one-third to one-half, then adjust to the INR.

harm.zh-CN: 她在服华法林期间出现了出血：先查INR，这时应停用华法林，而不只是减量。
harm.en: She is bleeding on warfarin: check the INR and withhold warfarin now, rather than merely reducing it.

response.zh-CN: 华法林已按新剂量开具。
response.en: Warfarin is charted at the reduced dose.

name.en: Continue warfarin at the current dose

dose.zh-CN: 维持当前华法林剂量不变。
dose.en: Keep the current warfarin dose unchanged.

harm.zh-CN: 胺碘酮抑制华法林代谢（CYP2C9和CYP1A2），剂量不变会在之后数天到数周内抗凝过度。如果她已经出血、INR很高，则必须停用华法林。
harm.en: Amiodarone inhibits warfarin metabolism (CYP2C9 and CYP1A2): an unchanged dose over-anticoagulates over the following days to weeks. If she is already bleeding with a high INR, warfarin must be withheld.

response.en: The warfarin dose is left unchanged.

dose.zh-CN: 加用胺碘酮时地高辛减量约一半或停用，监测心率。
dose.en: Reduce digoxin by about half (or stop it) when amiodarone starts, and watch the heart rate.

response.zh-CN: 地高辛剂量已调整。原报告没有说明地高辛是否改动，也没有地高辛血药浓度。
response.en: Digoxin is adjusted. The report does not say whether digoxin was changed and gives no digoxin level.

dose.zh-CN: 接下来数周每 2–3 天查一次INR，稳定后至少每周一次，按结果调整华法林。
dose.en: INR every 2–3 days for the next few weeks, then at least weekly once stable, adjusting warfarin to the results.

response.en: The INR monitoring plan is written into the orders.

dose.zh-CN: 请临床药师到床旁审核医嘱。
dose.en: Ask the clinical pharmacist to review the drug chart with you.

response.zh-CN: 临床药师与你一起看医嘱单，提醒你签字前先查清胺碘酮会怎样影响她正在用的华法林和地高辛。
response.en: The clinical pharmacist goes through the drug chart with you and asks you to check what amiodarone will do to her warfarin and digoxin before you sign it.

dose.zh-CN: 暂停华法林，复查INR后再决定何时恢复。
dose.en: Withhold warfarin and decide when to restart after repeat INR checks.

harm.zh-CN: 她术后才一周，刚置换三尖瓣生物瓣又有房颤：此时停用华法林会让她失去抗凝保护，应当减量而不是停药。
harm.en: One week after a tricuspid bioprosthesis, with atrial fibrillation, stopping warfarin leaves her without anticoagulant protection; reduce the dose rather than stop it.

name.zh-CN: 维生素K₁ 10 mg 肌内注射

harm.zh-CN: 出血尚未分级就给 10 mg（再重复一次），会把INR压到治疗范围以下，给重新抗凝带来困难。现行指南按出血严重程度决定是否逆转以及剂量和给药途径。
harm.en: Giving 10 mg (and repeating it) before the bleed has been graded pushes the INR below the therapeutic range and makes re-anticoagulation harder. Current guidance chooses whether to reverse, the dose and the route by the severity of the bleed.

name.zh-CN: 维生素K₁ 5–10 mg 缓慢静脉滴注
name.en: Vitamin K1 5–10 mg by slow IV infusion

dose.zh-CN: 维生素K₁ 5–10 mg稀释后缓慢静脉滴注。
dose.en: Vitamin K1 (phytomenadione) 5–10 mg, diluted, by slow IV infusion.

response.zh-CN: 已静脉滴注。这一剂量是大出血时与凝血酶原复合物合用的缓慢逆转部分；用于非大出血会让INR矫枉过正，给重新抗凝带来困难。
response.en: Given. At this dose vitamin K is the slow arm of reversal for major bleeding, given with a prothrombin complex concentrate; for a non-major bleed it overshoots and makes re-anticoagulation harder.

name.zh-CN: 人凝血酶原复合物（四因子PCC）

dose.zh-CN: 人凝血酶原复合物，按INR和体重给药，静脉输注。
dose.en: Four-factor prothrombin complex concentrate, IV, dosed by INR and weight.

harm.zh-CN: 病历中没有任何提示大出血的证据（未记录血红蛋白下降、血流动力学不稳定或关键部位出血）。凝血酶原复合物会给术后两周的生物瓣和房颤患者带来血栓风险；ACC 2020共识把逆转剂留给大出血。
harm.en: Nothing in the record makes this a major bleed (no haemoglobin fall, instability or critical site is recorded). A prothrombin complex concentrate brings a thrombotic risk to a two-week-old bioprosthesis with AF; ACC 2020 reserves reversal agents for major bleeding.

name.zh-CN: 出血停止后以较低剂量恢复华法林
name.en: Restart warfarin at a reduced dose once the bleeding has stopped

dose.zh-CN: 出血停止、INR回落后，以低于出血前的剂量恢复，按INR调整。
dose.en: Once the bleeding has stopped and the INR is down, restart at a lower dose than before the bleed and adjust to the INR.

harm.zh-CN: 她还在出血：要等血尿停止、INR回落后再恢复华法林。
harm.en: She is still bleeding: restart warfarin only once the haematuria has stopped and the INR has come down.

response.zh-CN: 已开具：出血停止、INR回落后以较低剂量恢复华法林，此后按INR调整。
response.en: Charted: warfarin restarts at a lower dose once the bleeding has stopped and the INR is down, then follows the INR.

response.zh-CN: 已停用。原报告指出胺碘酮停药后作用仍可持续 8–10 天，所以相互作用不会很快消失；她的房颤也需要另作节律或心室率控制安排。
response.en: Stopped. The report notes that amiodarone's effect persists for 8–10 days after stopping, so the interaction will not switch off quickly — and her AF will need another rhythm or rate plan.

name.zh-CN: 出院用药与出血风险宣教
name.en: Discharge teaching on bleeding signs and INR checks

dose.zh-CN: 向她讲解出血警示征象（血尿、黑便、异常淤斑或出血）、何时就医和INR复查计划。
dose.en: Explain the warning signs of bleeding (blood in the urine, black stools, unusual bruising or bleeding), when to seek help and the INR plan.

response.zh-CN: 你和她一起过了一遍出血警示征象、就医时机和INR复查安排。
response.en: You go through the warning signs, when to seek help and the INR checks with her.

hint.zh-CN: 问清症状持续多久、这一周有什么变化、以前做过什么心脏手术，再问过敏史和其他疾病——包括肾脏和泌尿系统。
hint.en: Find out how long the symptoms have gone on and what changed this week, what heart surgery she has had, then her allergies and other illnesses — kidneys and bladder included.

guidance.en: Take her history at the bedside.

hint.zh-CN: 查颈静脉、心脏、肺和下肢，比较腕部脉搏和心尖部心率；送检血常规、凝血、尿常规，并做心电图和超声，记下手术前的基线。
hint.en: Examine the neck veins, heart, chest and legs and compare the wrist pulse with the apical rate; send the blood count, clotting and urinalysis, and get the ECG and the scans — this is her pre-operative baseline.

guidance.zh-CN: 床旁查体，然后开基线检查。
guidance.en: Examine her at the bedside, then order the baseline tests.

title.en: Day 8 after surgery: review the drug chart

hint.zh-CN: 房颤在术后第8天复发，团队准备加用胺碘酮。签字前先看看她正在用哪些药，胺碘酮会对它们产生什么影响、多快出现。
hint.en: AF has come back on day 8 and the team wants to add amiodarone. Before you sign, look at what else she is taking and what amiodarone will do to each drug — and how quickly.

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅术后用药记录和INR，再到会诊板作答第1项决策并调整医嘱。
guidance.en: Read the post-operative drug chart and INRs, answer decision 1 on the case board and adjust the orders.

title.zh-CN: 术后第16天：评估新出现的问题
title.en: Day 16 after surgery: assess the new problem

hint.zh-CN: 看看尿液，查INR和尿检，看病历里关于出血程度有哪些、缺哪些；然后判断原因、你有多大把握，以及怎样止血又不让她失去抗凝保护。
hint.en: Look at the urine, check the INR and urine tests and see what the record does and does not say about how badly she is bleeding; then decide the cause, how sure you can be, and how to stop the bleeding without leaving her unprotected.

guidance.zh-CN: 床旁查看后调阅检查与记录，作答第2、3项决策并下达医嘱。
guidance.en: See her, read the results and records, answer decisions 2 and 3 and give your orders.

hint.zh-CN: 看原报告怎样处理、INR降到了多少；想想她回家后的几周里抗凝风险在哪里，谁来查、多久查一次。
hint.en: See how the report handled it and where the INR ended up; then think about where her anticoagulation risk lies over the coming weeks at home — and who checks it, and how often.

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅处理与出院记录，作答第4项决策，恢复抗凝并做出院宣教。
guidance.en: Read the treatment and discharge record, answer decision 4, restart anticoagulation and do the discharge teaching.

prompt.zh-CN: 术后第8天房颤复发（心率 81 次/分），INR 1.9，华法林 3.75 mg/d（第3天刚加量），同时在用地高辛 0.125 mg/d。团队计划加用胺碘酮 0.2 g每日1次。华法林和其他医嘱怎么处理？
prompt.en: On postoperative day 8 AF has recurred (heart rate 81/min); the INR is 1.9 on warfarin 3.75 mg/day (increased on day 3), and she is also on digoxin 0.125 mg/day. The team plans amiodarone 0.2 g once daily. What do you do with the warfarin and the rest of the chart?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅术后用药记录和术后INR。
need.en: First read the post-operative drug chart and INRs.

text.zh-CN: 开胺碘酮的同时预先把华法林减量约 1/3–1/2，此后数周每 2–3 天查INR，并复核地高辛（减半或停用）和心率控制药物
text.en: Start amiodarone with a pre-emptive warfarin reduction of about one-third to one-half, check the INR every 2–3 days for the following weeks, and review digoxin (halve or stop) and her rate-control drugs

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。胺碘酮及其代谢产物抑制CYP2C9和CYP1A2，使S-华法林浓度升高（原报告讨论）。美国胺碘酮说明书：合用后 3–4 天PT约延长一倍，应将华法林减量 1/3–1/2 并监测PT；同时复核地高辛，约减量一半或停用。原报告引用的减量幅度为 25%–50%，Sanoski与Bauman按胺碘酮维持剂量给出的减量为 200 mg/d时约 30%。
feedback.en: Correct. Amiodarone and its metabolite inhibit CYP2C9 and CYP1A2 and raise S-warfarin levels (the report's discussion). The US amiodarone label: co-administration roughly doubles the PT after 3–4 days — reduce warfarin by one-third to one-half and monitor the PT — and review digoxin, reducing it by about half or stopping it. The report cites a 25–50 % reduction; Sanoski and Bauman scale it to the amiodarone maintenance dose (about 30 % at 200 mg/day).

text.zh-CN: 华法林维持 3.75 mg/d：INR还没到 2.0，相互作用要几周后才会出现
text.en: Keep warfarin at 3.75 mg/day — the INR is still below 2.0 and the interaction takes weeks to appear

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，这正是原报告团队的做法。相互作用几天内就开始：说明书称 3–4 天后PT约延长一倍；原报告写明胺碘酮连续服用 4–5 天起效、5–7 天达作用高峰，并会持续累积数周（Sanoski：高峰约在第7周）。在刚加量、INR仍在上升（1.3→1.9）的华法林上叠加胺碘酮，最容易“冲过头”。
feedback.en: No — and this is what the report's team did. The interaction starts within days: the label says the PT roughly doubles after 3–4 days, the report notes that amiodarone acts after 4–5 days and peaks at 5–7 days, and the effect keeps building for weeks (Sanoski: peak around week 7). Adding amiodarone to a warfarin dose that was just increased, with the INR still climbing (1.3 → 1.9), is a set-up for overshoot.

text.zh-CN: 先停用华法林，等胺碘酮约一个月达到稳态后再重新开始
text.en: Stop warfarin until amiodarone reaches steady state in about a month, then start again

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她术后仅一周，刚置换三尖瓣生物瓣，又有房颤，停药一个月会让她暴露于瓣膜和心房血栓风险中（ESC/EACTS 2025瓣膜病指南：外科生物瓣术后早期的抗凝方案需个体化）。处理相互作用靠减量和密切监测，而不是停药。
feedback.en: No. One week after a tricuspid bioprosthesis, with AF, a month off anticoagulation exposes her to valve and atrial thrombus (ESC/EACTS 2025: early anticoagulation after a surgical bioprosthesis is individualised). The interaction is managed by reducing the dose and monitoring closely, not by stopping.

text.zh-CN: 趁胺碘酮还没起效，先把华法林加量，尽快达到目标范围
text.en: Increase warfarin now to reach the target range before amiodarone takes effect

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这会让两种作用叠加：华法林加量的效应和胺碘酮的抑制作用都在之后几天显现，INR可能急剧升高。合用时的方向是减量，而不是加量。
feedback.en: No. The two effects would stack: both the dose increase and amiodarone's inhibition show over the next days, and the INR can climb steeply. With this combination the dose goes down, not up.

prompt.zh-CN: 术后第16天：肉眼血尿，尿红细胞 300/μL，PT 60.0 s，INR 5.1（前两天为 2.2、2.4，期间华法林已两次减量）。最可能的解释是什么？你有多大把握？
prompt.en: Postoperative day 16: visible haematuria, urine red cells 300/µL, PT 60.0 s, INR 5.1 (2.2 and 2.4 on the two days before, despite two warfarin reductions). What is the most likely explanation, and how sure can you be?

need.zh-CN: 先问她小便的情况，并调阅术后第14–16天的INR、尿检和用药记录。
need.en: First ask about her urine and read the INRs, urine tests and drug chart for days 14–16.

text.zh-CN: 华法林–胺碘酮相互作用导致抗凝过度（加用胺碘酮时华法林未减量），术后早期状态和右心淤血可能也有影响；这是“很可能”而非“肯定”的药物相互作用，仍需排除尿路局部原因（导尿损伤、感染）
text.en: Over-anticoagulation from the warfarin–amiodarone interaction (warfarin not reduced when amiodarone started), perhaps helped by the early post-operative state and right-sided congestion — a probable rather than certain interaction, with a local urinary cause (catheter trauma, infection) still to exclude

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。时间关系吻合（合用 8 天后INR从 2.4 一天升到 5.1），术前尿常规和泌尿系超声正常、无泌尿生殖系统病史，都支持相互作用；停用华法林后INR是否回落、出血是否停止（去激发）还会提供证据。但单一病例、没有再激发，又有其他可能的促成因素（术后早期、术前右心淤血、进食情况和导尿史都未记录），因此更恰当的判断是“很可能”。
feedback.en: Correct. The timing fits (eight days into the combination the INR jumped from 2.4 to 5.1 in a day), and her pre-operative urinalysis and urinary ultrasound were normal with no genitourinary history — both support the interaction; whether the INR falls and the bleeding stops once warfarin is withheld (dechallenge) will add evidence. But it is one case, without rechallenge, and other contributors are possible (the early post-operative state, pre-operative right-sided congestion, and her intake and any catheter, which are not recorded), so “probable” is the fair grading.

text.zh-CN: 尿路局部原因（导尿损伤或感染），INR升高只是巧合
text.en: A local urinary cause — catheter trauma or infection — with the high INR a coincidence

feedback.zh-CN: 不太可能是主要原因。INR 5.1远高于治疗范围，而且一天内从 2.4 翻倍，抗凝过度本身就足以引起血尿；术前尿常规、泌尿系超声正常，也无泌尿生殖系统病史。不过导尿史和尿路症状病历都没记录，值得核实——抗凝过度会让局部病变更容易出血。
feedback.en: Unlikely to be the main cause. An INR of 5.1 is far above range and doubled from 2.4 in a day — enough on its own to cause haematuria — and her pre-operative urinalysis and urinary ultrasound were normal with no genitourinary history. Still, catheter history and urinary symptoms are not recorded and are worth checking: over-anticoagulation makes a local lesion bleed more easily.

text.zh-CN: 胺碘酮引起肝损伤，凝血因子合成减少
text.en: Amiodarone liver injury reducing clotting-factor production

feedback.zh-CN: 病历不支持。术后没有记录任何肝功能结果，术前肝脏超声正常；INR的变化方式与已知的华法林代谢受抑一致。在没有肝功能证据时，先按药物相互作用处理并补查肝功能，而不是先下肝损伤的结论。
feedback.en: The record does not support it: no liver tests are recorded after surgery and the pre-operative liver ultrasound was normal, while the INR pattern matches the known inhibition of warfarin metabolism. Without liver evidence, treat it as the interaction and check liver tests, rather than conclude liver injury.

text.zh-CN: 肯定是药物相互作用：术前尿检正常，已经排除了其他原因
text.en: Certainly the interaction: the normal pre-operative urine tests rule out any other cause

feedback.zh-CN: 这是原报告作者的结论（“故可以明确”），但证据支撑的是“很可能”而不是“肯定”。术前检查正常不能排除术后出现的导尿损伤或感染；单一病例没有再激发，其他促成因素也未排除。报告不良反应时应如实分级，不要把可能性写成确定性。
feedback.en: This is the authors' conclusion (“故可以明确” — “so it can be stated definitely”), but the evidence supports “probable”, not “certain”. Normal pre-operative tests cannot exclude catheter trauma or infection after surgery, there is no rechallenge in a single case, and other contributors are not excluded. Grade an adverse reaction honestly; do not turn likelihood into certainty.

prompt.zh-CN: 术后第16天，肉眼血尿，INR 5.1。病历里没有血红蛋白、血流动力学和输血资料。现在怎么处理抗凝和出血？
prompt.en: Postoperative day 16: visible haematuria with an INR of 5.1. The record has no haemoglobin, haemodynamic or transfusion data. How do you manage the anticoagulation and the bleeding now?

need.zh-CN: 先完成第2项决策，并调阅出血严重程度资料。
need.en: First answer decision 2 and read the bleeding-severity documentation.

text.zh-CN: 停用华法林，先按ACC 2020标准给出血分级（复查血红蛋白、评估血流动力学、有无血块或尿潴留、出血部位）；非大出血一般不用逆转剂，复查INR等它回落；只有大出血才静脉用维生素K₁并联合凝血酶原复合物
text.en: Withhold warfarin and first grade the bleed by the ACC 2020 criteria (repeat haemoglobin, haemodynamics, clots or retention, the site); a non-major bleed generally needs no reversal agent — recheck the INR as it falls; only a major bleed gets IV vitamin K1 with a prothrombin complex concentrate

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ACC 2020共识：大出血指关键部位出血、血流动力学不稳定，或显性出血伴血红蛋白下降 ≥ 2 g/dL或需输注 ≥ 2 单位红细胞；逆转剂一般不用于非大出血。本例病历缺少分级所需资料，所以第一步是补齐它们。若需要用维生素K₁，剂量和途径由出血程度决定，目标是止血而不是把INR压到正常。
feedback.en: Correct. ACC 2020: a major bleed is one at a critical site, with haemodynamic instability, or overt bleeding with a haemoglobin fall of ≥ 2 g/dL or ≥ 2 units of red cells transfused; reversal agents are generally not for non-major bleeds. This record lacks the data to grade it, so getting them is the first step. If vitamin K1 is used, its dose and route follow the bleed's severity — the aim is to stop the bleeding, not to normalise the INR.

text.zh-CN: 停用华法林，立即肌内注射维生素K₁ 10 mg，4小时后INR仍高就再注射一次
text.en: Withhold warfarin and give vitamin K1 10 mg intramuscularly now, repeating it after 4 h if the INR is still high

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，这是原报告团队的做法（间隔4小时两次肌注，共 20 mg；之后的INR见处理与出院记录）。出血还没分级就大剂量逆转，容易矫枉过正：20 mg维生素K₁可使INR降到她新生物瓣和房颤所需的范围以下，给重新抗凝带来困难。现行做法是先分级，再按严重程度决定是否逆转、剂量和途径（ACC 2020）。
feedback.en: No — and this is what the report's team did (two 10 mg intramuscular doses 4 h apart; the INRs that followed are in the treatment and discharge record). Reversing hard before the bleed is graded tends to overshoot: 20 mg of vitamin K1 can take the INR below the range her new bioprosthesis and AF need, which makes re-anticoagulation harder. Today: grade first, then decide whether to reverse, how much and by which route (ACC 2020).

text.zh-CN: 立即输注凝血酶原复合物并静脉用维生素K₁，让INR马上恢复正常
text.en: Give a prothrombin complex concentrate and IV vitamin K1 now to normalise the INR at once

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。病历中没有大出血的证据，ACC 2020共识把逆转剂留给大出血。对术后两周的生物瓣和房颤患者，把INR迅速完全纠正会带来不必要的血栓风险。
feedback.en: No. Nothing in the record shows a major bleed, and ACC 2020 reserves reversal agents for major bleeding. Rapid full correction of the INR adds an unnecessary thrombotic risk two weeks after a bioprosthesis, with AF.

text.zh-CN: 华法林继续用，按 2.25 mg/d再减一点，观察小便
text.en: Carry on with warfarin at a slightly lower dose than 2.25 mg/day and watch the urine

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。INR 5.1并且正在出血，必须先停用华法林；继续给药会让INR进一步升高。减量是在INR回到范围、出血停止后才考虑的事。
feedback.en: No. With an INR of 5.1 and active bleeding, warfarin is withheld first; giving more would push the INR higher. A lower dose is a decision for after the bleeding has stopped and the INR is back in range.

text.zh-CN: 永久停用华法林，改用阿司匹林
text.en: Stop warfarin for good and switch to aspirin

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。房颤加上刚置换的三尖瓣生物瓣需要口服抗凝，阿司匹林不能替代。ACC 2020共识：大多数患者在医学上安全时就应尽早恢复抗凝。
feedback.en: No. AF with a newly implanted tricuspid bioprosthesis needs oral anticoagulation, which aspirin does not replace. ACC 2020: in most patients anticoagulation is restarted as soon as it is medically safe.

prompt.zh-CN: 按原报告：次日恢复华法林 1.50 mg/d，INR 1.4，当天出院，继续服用胺碘酮。出院计划最需要补上的是什么？
prompt.en: As reported: warfarin restarted at 1.50 mg/day the next day with an INR of 1.4, discharged that day, still on amiodarone. What does the discharge plan most need?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅处理与出院记录。
need.en: First read the treatment and discharge record.

text.zh-CN: 出院后几天内复查INR，此后至少每周复查直至稳定，按INR调整华法林——胺碘酮的作用还会持续累积数周；同时复核地高辛，并教她识别出血征象和就医时机
text.en: An INR within a few days of discharge and then at least weekly until stable, adjusting warfarin to it — the amiodarone effect keeps building for weeks; also review digoxin and teach her the bleeding warning signs and when to seek help

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。她出院时INR 1.4，低于常用的房颤维生素K拮抗剂目标范围（INR 2.0–3.0），同时胺碘酮约一个月才达稳态（原报告），相互作用高峰可在数周后（Sanoski）——剂量需求会继续变化。尽早、频繁地复查INR，加上地高辛复核和出血宣教，才能在“出血”和“血栓”两端之间保持平衡（ACC 2020：在安全时尽早恢复抗凝并密切监测）。
feedback.en: Correct. She went home with an INR of 1.4, below the usual VKA target in AF (INR 2.0–3.0), while amiodarone takes about a month to reach steady state (the report) and the interaction can peak weeks later (Sanoski) — so her dose needs will keep shifting. Early and frequent INR checks, a digoxin review and bleeding teaching keep her between bleeding and clotting (ACC 2020: restart when safe and monitor closely).

text.zh-CN: INR已经降下来了，三个月后瓣膜门诊复查一次就够了
text.en: The INR is down now, so a check at the three-month valve clinic is enough

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胺碘酮的作用还会累积数周，华法林剂量需求在出院后仍会变化；三个月不查INR，既可能再次出血，也可能因抗凝不足出现血栓。
feedback.en: No. Amiodarone's effect keeps building for weeks, so her warfarin needs will change after discharge; three months without an INR risks both another bleed and a clot from under-anticoagulation.

text.zh-CN: 出血后应停用华法林至少一周，次日恢复太早了，应再次停药
text.en: Warfarin should be withheld for at least a week after a bleed — restarting the next day was too early, so stop it again

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。血尿已停止、尿红细胞转阴，而她有房颤和两周前置换的生物瓣，血栓风险真实存在。ACC 2020共识：大多数患者在医学上安全时就应尽早恢复抗凝。问题不在于恢复太早，而在于随后的监测计划。
feedback.en: No. The haematuria has stopped and the urine red cells are negative, while her AF and two-week-old bioprosthesis carry a real thrombotic risk. ACC 2020: in most patients anticoagulation is restarted as soon as it is medically safe. The problem is not the early restart but the monitoring that follows it.

text.zh-CN: 停用胺碘酮，华法林恢复到原来的 3.75 mg/d
text.en: Stop amiodarone and go back to the previous 3.75 mg/day warfarin dose

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。原报告指出胺碘酮停药后作用仍可持续 8–10 天，而且它清除缓慢、相互作用只会逐渐消退，所以华法林剂量需求在之后一段时间里都会漂移；直接回到 3.75 mg/d有再次过量的风险。是否继续胺碘酮是节律控制的另一个决定，无论怎样都需要按INR滴定华法林。
feedback.en: No. The report notes that amiodarone's effect lasts 8–10 days after stopping, and because it is cleared slowly the interaction fades only gradually, so her warfarin needs would keep drifting, and going straight back to 3.75 mg/day risks another overshoot. Whether to continue amiodarone is a separate rhythm decision; either way warfarin is titrated to the INR.

text.zh-CN: 入院问诊：病程、伴随症状、既往心脏手术、过敏史及其他疾病（含泌尿生殖系统）
text.en: Admission history: course, associated symptoms, previous heart surgery, allergies and other illness (genitourinary included)

text.zh-CN: 入院查体：生命体征、颈静脉、心脏和下肢
text.en: Admission examination: vital signs, neck veins, heart and legs

text.zh-CN: 记录术前基线：血常规、凝血、尿常规、心电图、超声心动图和泌尿系超声
text.en: Recorded the pre-operative baseline: blood count, clotting, urinalysis, ECG, echo and urinary ultrasound

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择加用胺碘酮时预先减少华法林并密切监测INR，并据此下达医嘱
text.en: Chose a pre-emptive warfarin reduction with close INR checks when amiodarone started, at the first attempt, and ordered it

text.zh-CN: 没有在加用胺碘酮后维持华法林原剂量
text.en: Did not keep warfarin at full dose alongside amiodarone

text.zh-CN: 加用胺碘酮时复核并调整地高辛
text.en: Reviewed and adjusted digoxin when amiodarone started

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把血尿归因于很可能的华法林–胺碘酮相互作用，并保留对其他原因的鉴别
text.en: Attributed the haematuria to a probable warfarin–amiodarone interaction, keeping other causes open, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即先给出血分级、不对非大出血用逆转剂，并停用华法林
text.en: Graded the bleed before any reversal and withheld warfarin, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 没有给予肌内注射维生素K₁或凝血酶原复合物
text.en: Gave neither intramuscular vitamin K1 nor a prothrombin complex concentrate

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即制定出院后密切INR监测计划，恢复华法林并做出血宣教
text.en: Planned close INR follow-up after discharge at the first attempt, restarted warfarin and taught the bleeding signs

text.zh-CN: 向患者解释发生了什么，以及出院后的抗凝和复查安排
text.en: Explained to her what happened and the anticoagulation and INR plan after discharge

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现：用通俗语言说明血尿与两种药相互影响、抗凝过强有关，坦诚这是可能而非确定的结论；解释为什么还要继续吃华法林（新瓣膜和房颤的血栓风险）；具体说明什么时候、在哪里查INR，哪些出血征象需要马上就医；请她复述要点，并回应她的担心。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance: explains in plain words that the bleeding came from two medicines interacting and thinning her blood too much, and is honest that this is likely rather than certain; explains why she still needs warfarin (clot risk with the new valve and AF); gives specific timing and place for INR checks and the bleeding signs that need urgent help; asks her to repeat the key points back and responds to her worries.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士：负责发药、记录出入量和执行医嘱。医嘱单和检查结果可在护士站电脑上调阅；病房有心电图机、药柜和抢救车，超声需要从影像科推来。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果数值，不解读、不作诊断；被问到病历里没有的内容（如导尿情况、术后血红蛋白）时如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse: gives the medicines, records intake and output and carries out orders. The drug chart and results are on the station computer; the ward has an ECG cart, a medicines cabinet and a crash cart, and an ultrasound machine has to be brought from imaging. Reads orders back, reports values only for results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not in the record (a urinary catheter, a post-operative haemoglobin).

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师，与学员一起审核医嘱。可以讲解：华法林是S-和R-对映体的消旋体，分别经CYP2C9和CYP1A2代谢；胺碘酮及脱乙基胺碘酮抑制两者；胺碘酮口服吸收慢且不规则，约一个月达稳态，停药后作用仍持续，因此相互作用会在数天到数周内逐步加强；美国胺碘酮说明书建议合用时华法林减量 1/3–1/2 并监测PT，地高辛减量约一半或停用。先问学员“胺碘酮会对她的华法林和地高辛做什么”，听到学员的方案后再给具体数字。只讨论学员已经看到的结果，不提前说出INR数值或诊断。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist who reviews the chart with the learner. Can explain: warfarin is a racemate whose S and R forms are metabolised by CYP2C9 and CYP1A2; amiodarone and desethylamiodarone inhibit both; amiodarone is absorbed slowly and erratically, reaches steady state in about a month and keeps acting after it is stopped, so the interaction builds over days to weeks; the US amiodarone label advises reducing warfarin by one-third to one-half with PT monitoring, and reducing digoxin by about half or stopping it. Asks the learner first what amiodarone will do to her warfarin and digoxin, and gives numbers only after hearing the learner's plan. Discusses only results the learner has seen and never states INR values or a diagnosis ahead of them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已获得的资料提问，例如：“她的桡动脉脉搏和心尖心率为什么不一样？”“胺碘酮会怎样影响华法林？多快出现？”“为什么INR在两次减量后还会一天翻倍？”“这次出血算大出血吗？你还需要知道什么？”“出血之后，两周前置换的生物瓣加上房颤，她需要怎样的INR？”“你有多大把握说是胺碘酮引起的？”。可以讲ACC 2020抗凝出血共识、ESC 2024房颤和ESC/EACTS 2025瓣膜病指南的相关原则。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的数据（术后血红蛋白、导尿情况、出院后INR均无记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “Why do her radial pulse and apical rate differ?”, “What will amiodarone do to her warfarin, and how fast?”, “Why did the INR double in a day after two dose cuts?”, “Is this a major bleed — what else do you need to know?”, “After the bleed, what INR does she need two weeks after a bioprosthesis, with AF?”, “How sure can you be that amiodarone caused it?”. May explain the relevant principles of the ACC 2020 pathway on bleeding with oral anticoagulants, ESC 2024 AF and ESC/EACTS 2025 valvular disease. Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (a post-operative haemoglobin, catheter use and INRs after discharge are not recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：胺碘酮–华法林相互作用、INR升高与血尿
title.en: Debrief: the amiodarone–warfarin interaction, a rising INR and haematuria

conclusion.zh-CN: 三尖瓣生物瓣置换、二尖瓣成形及房颤消融术后服用华法林，术后第8天加用胺碘酮时华法林未减量；8 天后INR升至 5.1并出现肉眼血尿，最可能是华法林–胺碘酮相互作用所致（很可能，而非原文所称的“肯定”）。原报告停用华法林并两次肌注维生素K₁ 10 mg，次日INR 1.4、尿红细胞转阴，以 1.50 mg/d恢复华法林并于术后第17天出院；出院后的INR和结局未报告。
conclusion.en: On warfarin after a bioprosthetic tricuspid valve replacement, mitral repair and AF ablation, she started amiodarone on postoperative day 8 without a warfarin reduction; eight days later the INR was 5.1 with visible haematuria — most likely the warfarin–amiodarone interaction (probable, not the “definite” the report claims). The report stopped warfarin and gave vitamin K1 10 mg intramuscularly twice; the next day the INR was 1.4 and the urine red cells negative, warfarin was restarted at 1.50 mg/day and she went home on postoperative day 17. INRs and outcome after discharge are not reported.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 加用胺碘酮时华法林维持原剂量（刚加量后、INR仍在上升），是这次过度抗凝的关键处方环节。
keyReasoning.en: Keeping warfarin at full dose when amiodarone started — just after a dose increase, with the INR still rising — was the key prescribing step behind the over-anticoagulation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: INR在两次减量后仍一天翻倍：相互作用延迟出现、逐步累积，减量来得太晚。
keyReasoning.en: The INR doubled in a day despite two dose cuts: the interaction is delayed and cumulative, and the reductions came too late.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 术前尿常规和泌尿系超声正常、无泌尿生殖系统病史、停药后好转，支持相互作用；但单一病例只能判为“很可能”。
keyReasoning.en: Normal pre-operative urine tests and urinary ultrasound, no genitourinary history and improvement on withdrawal support the interaction — but a single case grades it as probable.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 出血的处理取决于分级；病历缺少血红蛋白和血流动力学资料，大剂量肌注维生素K₁使INR降到治疗范围以下。
keyReasoning.en: Bleeding management depends on grading; the record lacks haemoglobin and haemodynamic data, and large intramuscular vitamin K1 doses took the INR below range.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 新生物瓣和房颤的血栓风险要求尽早、以较低剂量恢复抗凝，并在出院后密切监测INR。
keyReasoning.en: The thrombotic risk of a new bioprosthesis with AF calls for an early, lower-dose restart and close INR monitoring after discharge.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是一例单中心的历史病例报告，不能证明某种剂量调整或逆转方案的效果。报告没有给出术后血红蛋白、肝肾功能、地高辛浓度、导尿情况、INR目标范围和出院后的结果；本病例中的决策、干预选项和评分是教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single historical case report and cannot show the effect of any dose adjustment or reversal strategy. The report gives no post-operative haemoglobin, renal or liver tests, digoxin level, catheter history, target INR or results after discharge; the decisions, intervention options and scoring here are teaching design and do not change the published course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血尿时的血红蛋白、血流动力学、输血需要和导尿情况。
unknowns.en: Haemoglobin, haemodynamics, transfusion needs and catheter use at the time of the haematuria.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术后肝肾功能、地高辛浓度以及胺碘酮加用后的心率。
unknowns.en: Post-operative renal and liver tests, the digoxin level and the heart rate after amiodarone.

unknowns.zh-CN: 团队的INR目标范围、出院后的INR和之后有无再次出血或血栓。
unknowns.en: The team's target INR, INRs after discharge and any later bleeding or thrombosis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 加用胺碘酮时预先减少华法林。胺碘酮及其代谢产物抑制CYP2C9和CYP1A2，使S-华法林浓度升高（原报告讨论）。美国胺碘酮说明书：合用后 3–4 天PT约延长一倍，华法林应减量 1/3–1/2 并监测PT；原报告引用 25%–50%；Sanoski与Bauman按胺碘酮维持剂量给出 400/300/200/100 mg/d时分别减少 40%/35%/30%/25%。历史与现行：原报告团队加用胺碘酮时维持 3.75 mg/d，8 天后INR升至 5.1 并出现血尿。
teachingPoints.en: Reduce warfarin pre-emptively when amiodarone starts. Amiodarone and its metabolite inhibit CYP2C9 and CYP1A2 and raise S-warfarin levels (the report's discussion). The US amiodarone label: co-administration roughly doubles the PT after 3–4 days — reduce warfarin by one-third to one-half and monitor the PT; the report cites 25–50 %; Sanoski and Bauman scale it to the amiodarone maintenance dose (40/35/30/25 % at 400/300/200/100 mg/day). Then and now: the report's team kept 3.75 mg/day when amiodarone started, and eight days later the INR was 5.1 with haematuria.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 相互作用延迟出现、而且不是线性的。INR 1.9→2.2→2.4后一天跳到 5.1，期间华法林已两次减量。原报告：胺碘酮口服吸收慢且不规则，连续服用 4–5 天起效、5–7 天达作用高峰，约一个月达稳态，停药后作用仍持续 8–10 天；Sanoski：相互作用高峰约在第7周。所以合用后要在数周内每隔几天查一次INR，而不是等INR升高再追着减量。
teachingPoints.en: The interaction is delayed and non-linear. The INR went 1.9 → 2.2 → 2.4 and then jumped to 5.1 in a day, despite two dose cuts. The report: oral amiodarone is absorbed slowly and erratically, acts after 4–5 days, peaks at 5–7 days, reaches steady state in about a month and keeps acting for 8–10 days after stopping; Sanoski: the interaction peaks around week 7. So check the INR every few days for weeks after the start, rather than chasing a rising INR with late reductions.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 先给出血分级，再决定是否逆转（ACC 2020共识）。大出血：关键部位出血、血流动力学不稳定，或显性出血伴血红蛋白下降 ≥ 2 g/dL或输注 ≥ 2 单位红细胞；逆转剂一般不用于非大出血。CHEST 2012（ACCP第9版）：INR 4.5–10且无出血时不建议常规使用维生素K。本例病历缺少分级资料。历史与现行：原报告 8 小时内肌注维生素K₁共 20 mg，次日INR降到 1.4。
teachingPoints.en: Grade the bleed before choosing reversal (ACC 2020 decision pathway). Major bleeding: a critical site, haemodynamic instability, or overt bleeding with a haemoglobin fall of ≥ 2 g/dL or ≥ 2 units of red cells transfused; reversal agents are generally not for non-major bleeds. CHEST 2012 (ACCP 9th edition): no routine vitamin K for an INR of 4.5–10 without bleeding. This record lacks the data to grade the bleed. Then and now: the report gave 20 mg of intramuscular vitamin K1 within 8 h, and the INR was 1.4 the next day.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 在医学上安全时尽早恢复抗凝（ACC 2020共识），并以较低剂量、密切监测重新开始。她有房颤和两周前置换的三尖瓣生物瓣：ESC 2024房颤指南和ESC/EACTS 2025瓣膜病指南都要求权衡血栓风险，术后早期抗凝方案需个体化。原报告次日以 1.50 mg/d恢复，当天出院，但没有记录出院后的INR监测。
teachingPoints.en: Restart anticoagulation as soon as it is medically safe (ACC 2020), at a lower dose with close monitoring. She has AF and a two-week-old tricuspid bioprosthesis: ESC 2024 AF and ESC/EACTS 2025 valvular disease both weigh the thrombotic risk, and early post-operative anticoagulation is individualised. The report restarted 1.50 mg/day the next day and discharged her that day, but records no INR follow-up after discharge.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 看完整个医嘱单。她在用地高辛 0.125 mg/d：美国胺碘酮说明书建议加用胺碘酮时复核地高辛，约减量一半或停用；原报告没有说明地高辛是否调整，也没有地高辛血药浓度或心率记录。
teachingPoints.en: Read the whole drug chart. She was on digoxin 0.125 mg/day: the US amiodarone label advises reviewing digoxin when amiodarone starts and reducing it by about half or stopping it; the report does not say whether digoxin was changed and records no digoxin level or later heart rate.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 如实给不良反应分级。作者写“故可以明确”，但单一病例只有合理的时间关系和停药后好转，没有再激发，术后早期状态、术前右心淤血、进食和导尿情况也未排除，因此更恰当的结论是“很可能”的药物相互作用。
teachingPoints.en: Grade an adverse drug reaction honestly. The authors write that the cause “can be stated definitely”, but one case with a plausible time course and improvement on withdrawal — no rechallenge, and with the early post-operative state, pre-operative right-sided congestion, intake and catheter use not excluded — supports a probable interaction, not a certain one.
